visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with brown hair styled in a bun wearing a white long-sleeved shirt, black tie, and short black skirt walks confidently towards the camera in an outdoor setting. The background is a gray slatted wall with large 'OASIS' lettering. She poses by touching her hair and raising her arms to show off her outfit. (2) The scene cuts to the woman sitting in the driver's seat of a gray Tesla car. She looks at the camera with a surprised expression and begins speaking. The car interior is sleek and well-lit. (3) She is seen standing next to the gray Tesla at an outdoor EV charging station. She walks to the back of the car, opens the charging port, and inserts a heavy black charging plug. (4) She stands on a sidewalk in front of a large turquoise sign for 'EVOASIS' charging station, gesturing with her hands as she explains features to the camera. (5) She stands in front of a white charging kiosk with a digital screen, pointing at the display and the charging nozzle while smiling and speaking. (6) She walks through a turquoise-painted parking lot area, squatting down to point at the '03 EVOASIS' markings on the ground. (7) Back in front of the gray slatted wall with 'EVOASIS' branding, she speaks energetically to the camera. (8) The scene shifts to her in a white mini skirt and white cardigan, pointing at a price comparison chart overlaid on the screen next to an EVOASIS logo. (9) Finally, she makes a heart shape with her arms above her head while smiling warmly at the camera in front of the price chart overlay.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 當你變成OL開始走秀. (2) [Logo]: EVOASIS. [Subtitle]: !!. (3) [Subtitle]: 沒錯, 我現在剛下班. 我現在在三重區三信路. 超級綠洲這邊充電. (4) [Subtitle]: EVOASIS充電站. 他們的站點最多. 優惠最多. 一度電才5塊多而已! 全部充電站比價下來. 他們真的優惠超級多的. (5) [Subtitle]: 最重要是他們. 提供電流跟電壓也很高. 所以每次充電. 都可以充非常快. 就不用等這麼久了. (6) [Subtitle]: 我每次來這邊都不用排隊. 因為這邊有8格的充電格. (7) [Subtitle]: 綠洲充電站在雙北. 大型充電站要開幕囉. 在淡水, 新店, 北投. 都有充電站了. (8) [Subtitle]: 三重站有搭配. 星空電價 晴空電價. 超級划算的. 信用卡 加值 充電金. 最高可享 10% 紅利回饋. (9) [Slogan]: 再搭配 「史上最強充電聯盟」. 聯邦綠卡：10% 回饋. 永豐 GREEN 卡：5% 回饋. 台新玫瑰卡 & 太陽卡：3.3%.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a promotional advertisement for the EVOASIS electric vehicle charging network in Taiwan. By featuring an attractive influencer in an 'Office Lady' persona, it aims to capture attention and then provide detailed information about charging speed, station density, competitive pricing, and credit card rewards to encourage EV owners to use their service.
